learning_outcomes.text: The student can name the topics covered in the course.
The student can predict the output of given Python code.

The student can design and program a working solution to solve given A.I. problems using Python and associated libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, Matplotlib, Pandas, OpenCV, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, etc. as seen during the exercises.
The student can explain the code of this AI solution and justify the choices made.

assessment_methods.method: Written exam during the examination period

assessment_rules: The evaluation consists of two parts: a 33% written exam and a 67% project (demonstration and defense). Python-specific concepts of the project (classes, correct use of libraries, code structure, ...) are evaluated. AI-specific concepts are evaluated via the AI Applications course for students who also take this course. For resits, the same modalities apply as in the first examination period, and there are no partial transfers for this course.
